verification.notes: Alexander Smirnov was sentenced to six years, and current reporting documents a later medical furlough without a public forwarding location. But official and court reporting describes him as a dual U.S.-Israeli citizen who surrendered both passports and as a source with Russian intelligence contacts; it does not establish that he was an Israeli intelligence agent. Several central details are therefore true, but the intelligence-role and only-passport assertions are unsupported or contradicted.
